# Table Builder

> PHP table definitions, command endpoints and published React views for Laravel/Inertia applications. Read installed-version documentation and application instructions before changing an integration.

## Application integration

- [Documentation index](docs/README.md): consumer and contributor guide map.
- [Getting started](docs/consumers/getting-started.md): requirements, installation, authorized controller and React page.
- [Tables](docs/consumers/tables.md): fluent builders, subclasses, registry factories and public APIs.
- [Columns](docs/consumers/columns.md): formatting, identity, visibility, search and sort callbacks.
- [React](docs/consumers/react.md): published components, props, custom renderers and themes.
- [State and pagination](docs/consumers/state-and-pagination.md): URL namespaces, reset values and cursor links.
- [Actions](docs/consumers/actions.md): authorization, eligibility, mutation and lifecycle behavior.
- [Exports](docs/consumers/exports.md): downloads, selected/filtered output and trusted worker context.
- [HTTP contract](docs/consumers/http-contract.md): payloads, command fields, responses and errors.
- [Troubleshooting](docs/consumers/troubleshooting.md): common integration failures.
- [Laravel Boost](docs/boost.md): opt-in package guidance and skills.

## Package maintenance

- [Contributing](docs/development/contributing.md): repository structure and change workflow.
- [Testing](docs/development/testing.md): validation commands and coverage boundaries.
- [Agent workflow](docs/development/agent-workflow.md): evidence and contributor conventions.
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): internals and namespaces.
- [Releasing](docs/development/releasing.md): release checks, archives and publishing.

This is a local documentation index. Boost discovers resources through `resources/boost`; it does not depend on this file.
